design_language: Scandinavian minimalism, premium automotive design, dark graphite surfaces, warm champagne gold accents, ivory typography, subtle glass effects.
brand_personality: Trustworthy, premium, Norwegian, intelligent, calm, fast, effortless.

visual_enhancers.corner_radius: rounded-2xl for main panels, rounded-full for pills/chips

map.style: MapLibre custom JSON. Dark monochrome base. Land: #090C0F, Water: #06090A, Roads: #141A1F.
map.route_line: Color #CBA365 with line-width 4 and 0.5 opacity outer glow.
map.vehicle_icon: Custom SVG. Elegant top-down silhouette of a premium sedan, colored #F4F4F0 with a subtle #CBA365 halo/glow underneath to indicate availability.

smart_booking_panel.greeting: Fraunces text-xl or text-2xl. e.g., 'God kveld, Usman.'
smart_booking_panel.suggestion: Inter Tight text-sm text-[#8A9198]. e.g., 'På vei hjem? Tøyen → 8 min'
smart_booking_panel.search_input: Large tap target, bg-white/5, subtle inner border. 'Hvor vil du? ⌕'

vehicle_selector_sheet.layout: Horizontal scrolling cards. 3 tiers: KJAPP, KJAPP+, KJAPP XL.
vehicle_selector_sheet.content: Vehicle image/icon, Title (KJAPP+), ETA (4 min), Price (189 kr).

driver_card.layout: Floating over map post-booking. High visual prominence.
driver_card.badge: Subtle gold outline pill. '✓ Verifisert løyvehaver'

kjapp_assist.trigger: Floating Action Button or prominent input section with an elegant 'KJAPP Assist' label and subtle AI sparkle icon.
kjapp_assist.ui: Chat interface using Fraunces for AI persona voice, large input area supporting voice dictation. Dark glassmorphism.

side_menu.layout: Full-height dark panel (#06090A) sliding from left or covering screen.
side_menu.links: Massive typography (text-2xl to 3xl) with ample padding (py-6).

splash_screen.content: Centered text. 'KJAPP' in Fraunces, 'NORDIC TAXI' tracking-[0.2em] below.
splash_screen.animation: Extremely minimalist. The 'A' in KJAPP receives a subtle gold diagonal shimmer/sweep.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_system: Use generous padding. p-6 or p-8 for panels. Avoid cramped elements.

booking_choreography.0_400ms: Bottom panel slides down slightly. Map bounds animate to fit pickup and dropoff points (ease-in-out).
booking_choreography.400_1000ms: Route line dynamically draws from A to B.
booking_choreography.1000_1600ms: KJAPP vehicle icons rotate and glide towards pickup.
booking_choreography.1600_2000ms: Vehicle sheet slides up. Prices/ETAs fade in.
booking_choreography.2000ms: 'BESTILL KJAPP' CTA button scales up and pulses.

motion.general: Smooth transitions (0.3s ease), avoid bouncy/springy animations. Aim for heavy, premium, automotive momentum.

accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48px height for all interactive elements (chips, inputs, buttons).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.

driver_app_parity.instructions: Maintain the exact same dark graphite/gold design language. Use large tap zones for 'Accept Ride' (Aksepter tur). Present earnings with elegant typography. The driver app must feel just as luxurious as the passenger app.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a Next.js/React or pure React + Tailwind architecture. Use MapLibre GL JS for the map with custom dark styling. Build the UI components overriding Shadcn defaults heavily to remove generic SaaS borders/colors. Apply the #0B1013 background globally. NEVER use generic blue or pure white backgrounds. The map is the hero. Use Framer Motion for the choreographies.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic SaaS UI. Do not center layouts by default. Use glassmorphism over map elements (DO NOT use full transparency for text overlays). Add data-testid to everything. Use modern pill-shaped or rounded-2xl buttons. Do not use AI emojis. Respect the Scandinavian minimalist premium automotive aesthetic.
